text:
maria gonzalez: Quick brainstorm: add a compact 'soft-defer' flow in Console for automatic fallback. Allow ops to pick a defer window (30s / 2m / 5m) before flipping into a degrade mode. tiny mock: https://redwood.mock/designs/soft-defer
ken li: Good. Which signals should trigger? error_rate only or latency / queue depth too?
olga petrov: Multi-signal preferred. e.g. error_rate > 5% OR p95_latency > 600ms for N secs OR queue_depth > 50. Audit tags: model_unreachable, high_latency, quota_exhausted.
maria gonzalez: UX: show active trigger, sampled request IDs (click to replay), one-click 'force fallback' with TTL + operator note.
samir rao: Add a 'replay sample' button that opens eval harness with exact prompt+ctx for faster debugging.
olga petrov: RBAC: only rollout-ops/dev leads can force fallback. Operator notes must write to audit stream.
ken li: For policy authoring expose a human-friendly JSON template in the UI, e.g. {"name":"soft-defer-v1","triggers":["error_rate","p95_latency"],"window":"30s","tags":["model_unreachable"],"operator_ttl":"10m"}
maria gonzalez: Also include an 'audit preview' showing last 5 times this rule would have fired (dry-run) before enabling.
samir rao: Telemetry: record decision_hash, signal_snapshot, sampled_request_ids, model_variant. Make entries linkable and CSV-exportable.
olga petrov: Edge-case: fallback could reduce quality. Add optional safety constraint: if route has tag quality_constrained=true, skip auto-fallback unless operator_bypass.
ken li: We'll implement policy priority: safety_check && trigger_match => flip, else only log. Operator-bypass allowed with RBAC.
deploy-bot: deploy success: rollout-service v2.14.7 deployed at 2025-09-12T15:03:01Z :rocket:
maria gonzalez: UX detail: audit lines should include short system 'why' plus optionally mandatory operator free-text when forcing fallback.
samir rao: +1 to Slack/email notify toggle for high-importance routes when auto-fallback triggers.
olga petrov: Can prototype this week. I'll mock narrow-screen variants.
maria gonzalez: I'll post mocks and acceptance criteria in #design. Any objections?
ken li: No objections. One perf caveat: sampling must be cheap; avoid fetching full traces for every decision. Sample ids only.
